blocks.en: After the augmentation process, the dataset increased to a total image of 8187. Even though our dataset was augmented using a strategically derived formula-based approach that dynamically varied the number of augmentations applied to images for each category, the risks of overfitting still persisted. Hence, to mitigate further overfitting issues, 25% of the augmented dataset was intentionally discarded. This step ensured that the model did not learn redundant patterns or become biased toward augmented data, thus maintaining the model’s generalization capability on unseen data. This resulted in 6138 images for training purposes. The figure 3.6 demonstrates the class distribution of the final training dataset, as the 25% discard stabilizes the dataset a bit further. The training dataset images are further enhanced using some more preprocessing techniques as illustrated in the figure . Normalization has been applied to normalize the pixel values to ensure consistent input distribution, Histogram Equalization to improve the contrast of the image by redistributing the intensity values of the pixels, and Gaussian blur to remove the noise and blurriness of the images.
blocks.zh: 扩容过程后,数据集的总图像增加到8187. 尽管我们利用一种基于公式的战略方法增加了我们的数据集,该方法动态地改变了适用于每个类别的图像的扩增次数,但过度调整的风险依然存在。 因此,为了进一步缓解过于适应的问题,25%的扩大数据集被故意放弃。 这一步骤确保了模型不会学到多余的模式,也不会偏向于扩大数据,从而保持模型在无形数据上的通缩能力。 结果产生了6138幅用于培训的图像。 图3.6显示了最终培训数据集的班级分布,因为25%的弃置使数据集更加稳定。 如图所示,利用一些更多的预处理技术,进一步加强了培训数据集的图像。 常态化已经应用到像素值的正常化,以确保一致的输入分布,直方图等效化通过再分配像素的强度值来改善图像的对比度,高斯文模糊化可以消除图像的噪音和模糊度.

blocks.en: Figure 3.6 : Graph showing class distribution of training dataset
blocks.zh: 图3.6:显示培训数据集的班级分布图

blocks.en: In order to ensure unbiased model evaluation, a separate test dataset of 620 images was curated by combining samples from various publicly available datasets. This ensures the result’s validity while mitigating any bias. Augmentation techniques were applied on the test dataset to introduce trap-image like challenges without oversampling. To thoroughly evaluate the model’s performance, the models were tested on both raw and augmented images, after preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 为了确保无偏见的模型评价,综合了各种公开数据集的样本,对由620幅图像组成的单独测试数据集进行了整理。 这确保了结果的有效性,同时减轻了任何偏见。 在测试数据集上应用了增强技术,以引入像挑战一样的陷阱图像,而不进行过度抽样. 为了彻底评估模型的性能,在经过预先处理后,这些模型在原始图像和放大图像上进行了测试。

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Reference Caption Generation for MLLM Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 MLLM评价参考说明生成

blocks.en: To evaluate the performance of the visual semantic extraction module, a total of 700 images were selected. This included 600 manually chosen samples from the existing test dataset, along with an additional 100 randomly selected animal images from other categories not present in the training set. Those 100 images were selected from the original animal detection images dataset. The inclusion of these 100 out-of-distribution images was specifically intended to assess the zero-shot capabilities of the MLLM. After the image dataset creation, the descriptions were crafted for each image, and a textual dataset was created. For all MLLM analysis, these 700 images, along with 700 textual descriptions, were used as the ground truth reference.
blocks.zh: 为了评价视觉语义提取模块的性能,共选取了700幅图像. 这包括从现有测试数据集中手动选取的600个样本,以及另外100个随机选取的来自培训集中没有的其他类别的动物图像。 这100幅图像是从原始的动物检测图像数据集中挑选出来的. 列入这100幅传播外图像,专门是为了评估MLLM的零射能力. 在图像数据集创建后,为每个图像设计了描述,并创建了文本数据集. 对于所有MLLM分析,这700张图像以及700张文字描述都被用作地面真理参考.

blocks.en: 3.3 CNN-based Classification and Object Detection Models
blocks.zh: 3.3 基于CNN的分类和物体探测模型

blocks.en: After the train-test split stage, four state-of-the-art models: Faster R-CNN, EfficientNetV2, ZF-Net, and YOLOv11. These four models are chosen based on their efficiency to analyze how these models perform on the dataset. Following that, the models are assessed based on how accurately they can provide a result that aligns with the motive of the study. The results are evaluated to meet the requirements needed for the research. If the outcomes are acceptable, the model can be used for further classification of unseen data. Otherwise, the model is fine-tuned until it meets the requirements.
blocks.zh: 列车试运行分级阶段后,有4个最先进的型号: 更快的R-CNN,高效NetV2,ZF-Net,以及YOLOv11. 这四个模型是根据其效率来分析这些模型在数据集上的表现的. 其后,根据模型能否准确提供符合研究动机的结果来评估模型。 对结果进行评价,以满足研究的需要。 如果结果可以接受,则该模型可用于对看不见的数据进行进一步分类。 否则,该型号会进行微调,直至达到要求.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Faster-RCNN
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 快速区域网

blocks.en: Faster R-CNN is an extension of Fast-RCNN that provides more rapid results by generating and ROI pooling the Region Proposal Networks (RPN) along with the Fast-RCNN backbone. ROI pooling utilizes max pooling to extract a uniform feature map, ensuring a fixed-size representation for regions of varying dimensions. RPN works like a selective search algorithm by telling the Fast-RCNN where to look. The RPN and the convolutional layers share the computations, making the detection process faster.
blocks.zh: 更快的R-CNN是Fast-RCN的延伸,通过生成和ROI集聚区域建议网络(RPN)与Fast-RCNN主干网一起提供更快的结果. ROI集合利用最大集合来提取一个统一的特征图,确保具有不同维度的区域有固定的大小代表. RPN通过告诉Fast-RCNN到哪里去寻找而像一个选择性的搜索算法. RPN和进化层共享计算,使得检测过程更快.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 EfficientNetV2
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 高效率网络V2

blocks.en: EfficientNetV2 is an improved version of the original EfficientNet architecture in terms of speed, accuracy and efficiency. The improvement came from three crucial optimizations which were- introducing Fused-MBConv Blocks, progressive learning strategy and using NAS - Neural architecture search. Implementation of Fused-MBConv blocks combined with MBConv blocks significantly increased the overall performance and accuracy while NAS helped to determine the best combination of these two. And the progressive learning strategy reduced the models training time to learn complex data by gradually increasing the size and regularization intensity.
blocks.zh: 高效 净额 V2在速度,准确度和效率方面是原始高效Net架构的改进版. 改进来自三个关键的优化,即Fused-MBConv Blocks、渐进学习战略以及使用NAS-神经结构搜索。 实施Fused-MBConv区块与MBConv区块相结合,大大提高了整体性能和准确性,而NAS则帮助确定这两个区块的最佳组合. 而渐进式学习策略通过逐步提高规模和规范化强度,减少了模型培训时间以学习复杂数据.

blocks.en: 3.3.3 ZF-Net
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 ZF-网络

blocks.en: ZF-Net is another SOTA model that uses smaller convolutional filters and smaller strides to ensure better feature extraction. ZFNet utilizes 7x7 filters in the early layers to capture large-scale features and transitions to 3x3 filters in later layers for finer detail extraction. This approach ensures effective feature representation while maintaining computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: ZF-Net是另一种SOTA模式,它使用较小的转录滤波器和较小的脚步以确保更好的特征提取. ZFNet在早期地层中利用7x7滤波器来捕捉大尺度的特性和向后层的3x3滤波器过渡,以进行更细细的细节提取. 这种做法确保了有效的特征表述,同时保持计算效率。

blocks.en: 3.3.4 YOLOv11

Yolov11 is the newest version of YOLO (you only look once), which consists of improved backbone and architecture with C3K2 block, C2PSA which is an improved attention mechanism and SPPF (Spatial Pyramid Pooling Fast). This refined architecture helps the model to detect smaller objects in a complex environment with greater accuracy by extracting critical features. Also the training procedure is much faster and optimized than the previous versions with the refined training pipeline.
blocks.zh: Yolov11是最新版本的YOLO(你只看一次),它由改进的骨干和建筑组成,带有C3K2块,C2PSA是改进的注意机制和SPPF(Spacial Pyramid Pooling Fast). 这种精细的架构通过提取关键特征,帮助模型在更精确的复杂环境中检测较小的物体. 此外,培训程序比以往经过精炼的培训程序更快速、更优化。

blocks.en: 3.4 Backbones for Faster-RCNN
blocks.zh: 3.4 快速区域网背骨

blocks.en: 3.4.1 ResNet 50
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 ResNet 50

blocks.en: Resnet50 is a prominent residual neural network (49 convolutional layers and 1 fully connected dense layer) used in various computer vision tasks such as object detection, image classification or segmentation. This network primarily solves the “vanishing gradient” problem during the training phase in deep neural networks. When it is adapted as a backbone, it functions as a feature extractor generating hierarchical features at different stages which are used for regional proposals and further classifications.
blocks.zh: Resnet50是一个突出的残留神经网络(49个转录层和1个全连接的密集层),用于各种计算机视觉任务,如物体检测,图像分类或分化. 这个网络主要解决深层神经网络培训阶段的“削弱梯度”问题。 当它被改编为骨干时,它作为一个特征提取器,在不同阶段产生等级特征,用于区域提案和进一步分类。

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Vision Transformer(ViT)
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 视变器(ViT)

blocks.en: Vision transformer is a renowned transformer architecture that has been used widely in the vision and language domain. In computer vision tasks, ViT interprets image inputs as a series of patches with a fixed size (16*16) for further processing. The patches are flattened and transformed into 1 dimensional vector and positional embeddings are incorporated to indicate the initial placements of the patches in the image. Unlike the CNN architecture’s, ViT computes self attention among all the patches which helps to gain global context from the very beginning and can detect dependencies among far-reaching patches. It has a CLS token which is attached to the patch embeddings at the beginning and is used to provide the final classification output. While implemented as a backbone, ViT encounters some difficulties such as- the computational complexity increases because of the global self-attention mechanism and it is comparatively less versatile in terms of input dimensions, which requires complex modifications to function with existing frameworks and to utilize it in object detection. Besides that, ViT can generate strong feature representations from images consisting of complex environments which is beneficial in computer vision.
blocks.zh: 视觉变流器是一种著名的变流器建筑,在视觉和语言领域被广泛使用. 在计算机视觉任务中,ViT将图像输入解释为一系列具有固定尺寸(16*16)的补丁,供进一步处理. 补丁被平整后转化为1维向量,并加入位置嵌入,以表示补丁在图像中的初始位置. 与CNN架构不同, ViT计算所有补丁中的自我关注, 它有一个CLS令牌,它附着在开始的补丁嵌入上,并用于提供最终的分类输出. 虽然ViT作为一个主干实施,但遇到一些困难,例如:由于全球自留机制,计算的复杂性增加,而且从输入维度来看,其多功能性相对较低,这就需要进行复杂的修改,以便与现有框架一起运作,并在物体检测中加以利用。 除此之外,ViT可以从由复杂环境组成的图像中产生强大的特征表示,这对计算机视觉有益.

blocks.en: 3.4.3 Swin Transformer
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 国家 Swin 变形器

blocks.en: Swin Transformer is an improved transformer architecture that fuses the benefits of attention mechanism and multi-scale feature extraction while maintaining linear complexity in computer vision tasks. The architecture is illustrated in figure 3.7 . It separates the input image into non-overlapping windows (7*7 patches) and computes self-attention among the neighbouring patches within that window. The shifted window mechanism leverages interaction among the non-overlapping neighbouring windows which helps to get a global perspective while maintaining linear complexity. The swin transformer has a 4 stage hierarchical structure, each consisting of two sections that computes window based multi-head self-attention and shifted window based multi-head self-attention alternatively. Compared to ViT, swin transformer works seamlessly as a backbone for object detection tasks because of its multi-scale feature production and compatibility with existing frameworks. The features extracted from different stages can be used by FPN directly to create feature pyramids in object detection tasks. Also, the computational cost is significantly less with the ability to extract both local and global features which is beneficial for processing complex environments.
blocks.zh: Swin Transformer是一种经过改进的变压器架构,它将注意机制和多尺度的特性提取的惠益融为一体,同时保持计算机视觉任务的线性复杂性. 结构图示 3.7 (英语). 它将输入图像分离为非重叠窗口(7*7补丁),并计算该窗口内相邻的补丁之间的自觉性. 转变后的窗口机制利用了非重叠的相邻窗口之间的相互作用,有助于获得全球视角,同时保持线性复杂性。 斯温变压器有4个级阶结构,每个级阶结构由两个部分组成,分别计算基于窗口的多头自留心和转向窗口的多头自留心. 与ViT相比,swin变压器由于具有多尺度的特性生产和与现有框架的兼容性,因此作为物体检测任务的骨干能够无缝工作. 从不同阶段提取的特征可以被FPN直接用于在对象检测任务中创建特征金字塔. 此外,计算成本要低得多,因为能够提取当地和全球的特性,从而有利于处理复杂的环境。

blocks.en: Figure 3.7 : Swin Transformer Architecture
blocks.zh: 图3.7:Swin变形器 建筑

blocks.en: 3.5 Feature Fusion Networks
blocks.zh: 3.5 特性融合网络

blocks.en: 3.5.1 Feature Pyramid Network
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 地物金字塔网络

blocks.en: Feature Pyramid Network is a neural network architecture used in the object detection task. It extracts feature maps at multiple scales to detect objects of different sizes. FPN can extract hierarchical features by constructing a top-down path with lateral connections to combine features of low resolution that are rich in semantics and features of high resolution that are rich in spatial information. This improves accuracy in detecting small objects and large objects simultaneously.
blocks.zh: 特性金字塔 网络是用于对象检测任务中的神经网络架构. 它在多个尺度上提取特征图,以检测大小不同的物体. FPN可以通过构建一个带有横向连接的自上而下路径来提取层次特征,将具有丰富语义的低分辨率特征和具有丰富空间信息的高分辨率特征结合起来. 这提高了同时探测小物体和大物体的准确性.

blocks.en: 3.5.2 Bi-Directional Feature Pyramid Network
blocks.zh: 3.5.2 双方向 地物金字塔网络

blocks.en: Bi-Directional Feature Pyramid Network (Bi-FPN) is a weighted feature pyramid network that is efficient in multiscale feature fusion, which makes it reliable for enhanced feature extraction. It allows the network to retain spatial information and aggregate features by adjusting the weights of each input feature map accordingly. This is faster as the regular convolutions are replaced with depthwise separable convolution. The combined top-down and bottom-up parsing, along with weighted future fusion, allows better feature extraction, which further helps the classification network to produce competitive results. Furthermore, Bi-FPN allows cross-scale connections that introduce additional connections between non-adjacent feature levels that enrich information flow. Bi-FPN produces superior feature fusion at both high and low levels and also shows significantly reduced computational overhead than FPN and PANet.
blocks.zh: 双方向 地物金字塔网络(英語:Bi-FPN)是一种加权地物金字塔网络,在多尺度地物聚变中是高效的,这使得它对于增强地物提取是可靠的. 它允许网络通过相应调整每个输入特征图的权重来保留空间信息和集合特征. 速度更快,因为正常的转动被深智分离的转动所取代. 自上而下和自下而上的组合解析,加上加权的未来聚变,可以进行更好的特征提取,这进一步帮助分类网络产生竞争性结果. 此外,Bi-FPN允许跨尺度连接,在非相邻特性级别之间引入额外的连接,丰富信息流动. Bi-FPN在高低水平上产生优异的特性聚变,也显示比FPN和PANet的计算间接费用显著降低.

blocks.en: 3.6 Multimodal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 3.6 多式联运大语文模式

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) are deep learning systems capable of understanding and generating content across multiple modalities: typically text, image, audio etc. Unlike traditional large language models that can only operate on texts, MLLMs are trained on multimodal data and can process information from various modalities seamlessly. This flexibility allows these models to be integrated with computer vision tasks such as object detection.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLM)是深层的学习系统,能够跨越多种模式理解和生成内容:典型的文本,图像,音频等. 与传统大语言模式只能在文本上运行不同,MLLMs接受多模式数据培训,能够无缝地处理不同模式的信息. 这种灵活性使得这些模型能够与物体检测等计算机视觉任务融合.

blocks.en: 3.6.1 LlaVa v1.5

LLaVa-1.5 is an advanced large multimodal model which incorporates LLM with a vision encoder through a Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) for tasks that require language and vision-related understanding such as image captioning, generating textual descriptions for images and question answering from the visual information. Vicuna is working as the foundational language model with a pre-trained vision encoder CLIP ViT-L/14. LLaVa models are capable of managing multiple images and prompts as inputs which makes it suitable for complex tasks. We have used two different versions of this model which are LLaVa-1.5-7B-hf and LLaVa-1.5-13B-hf.
blocks.zh: LLaVa-1.5是一种先进的大型多式联运模型,它通过多层感知器(MLP)将LLM与视觉编码器结合在一起,用于需要语言和视觉相关理解的任务,如图像字幕,生成图像的文字描述和从视觉信息中回答问题。 维库纳正作为基础语言模型工作,具有经过预先训练的视觉编码器CLIP VIT-L/14. 法学 Va模型能够管理多个图像和作为输入的提示,使其适合复杂的任务. 我们使用了这一模型的两个不同版本,即LLaVa-1.5-7B-hf和LLaVa-1.5-13B-hf。

blocks.en: LLaVa-1.5-7B-hf
blocks.zh: LLaVa - 1.5 - 7B - 小时

blocks.en: LLaVa-1.5-7B-hf architecture is based on transformer with 4 bit quantization and it utilizes Flash-attention 2 which makes it more optimized. The model has a total of 7.06 billion parameters with FP16 precision.
blocks.zh: LLaVa-1.5-7B-hf架构以4位量化的变压器为基础,并使用Flash-attention 2使其更加优化. 该模型共有70.6亿个参数,具有FP16精度.

blocks.en: LLaVa-1.5-13B-hf
blocks.zh: LLaVa-1.5-13B-小时

blocks.en: LLaVa-1.5-13B-hf is a more powerful model which is capable of advanced reasoning, generates better textual description with more detailed knowledge because of the parameter count being increased to 13 billion. This model has the same architecture as the 7B-hf version and is trained on the same dataset. The large number of parameters impacts the overall performance of this model and makes it more robust.
blocks.zh: LLaVa-1.5-13B-hf是一个更强大的模型,能够进行先进的推理,生成更好的文字描述,并且由于参数计数增加到130亿而获得更详细的知识. 这个模型的架构与7B-hf版本相同,并接受过同一数据集的培训. 大量的参数影响着这个模型的整体性能,使其更坚固.

blocks.en: 3.6.2 LlaVa v1.6 Mistral
blocks.zh: 3.6.2 LlaVa v1.6 米斯特拉尔

blocks.en: LLaVa mistral is another large multimodal model belonging to the LLaVa-Next family, which is known for its prominent efficiency in generating textual description of images with enhanced reasoning capability and OCR (Object Character Recognition). The model has Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 as the base language model with the pretrained vision encoder CLIP ViT-L/14 linked through the Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) with GELU activation. It was trained on approximately 7 billion parameters with an extensive dataset consisting of 558k image-text pairs with captions, 158k GPT generated multimodal instruction-following data, 500k academic task oriented data, 50k GPT-4 and 40k shareGPT data.
blocks.zh: 法学 Va mistral是另一个属于LLaVa-Next家族的大型多式联运模型,以在生成具有增强推理能力和OCR(Object C字符识别)的图像的文字描述方面显著的效率而闻名. 该模型有Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2作为基础语言模型,具有预训视觉编码器CLIP VIT-L/14通过多层感知器(MLP)与GELU激活连接. 它接受了大约70亿个参数的培训,其广泛的数据集包括558k的图像文本配对和标题,158k的GPT生成了多模式指令跟踪数据,500k的学术任务导向数据,50k的GPT-4和40k的共享GPT数据.

blocks.en: 3.6.3 KOSMOS 2
blocks.zh: 3.6.3 KOSMOS 2号公路

blocks.en: KOSMOS 2 is a transformer based Multimodal Large Language Model that is trained on the grounded image-text pairs known as the GRIT dataset. This pretrained model has grounding capability, which allows it to directly output the object’s coordinates as language tokens in Markdown syntax. The data format is similar to hyperlink. The model has a total of 1.6B trainable parameters, positioning it as relatively lightweight compared to other MLLM models.
blocks.zh: 韩国 2是一种基于变压器的Multimodle Lign Language Model,在被定位的图像文本对上训练,被称为GRIT数据集. 这个预先训练过的模型具有搁浅能力,这使得它能够直接输出对象的坐标作为马克当语法中的语言符号. 数据格式类似于超链接. 该型号共有1.6B型可列车参数,与其他MLLM型号相比定位为相对轻量级.

blocks.en: 3.6.4 IDEFICS
blocks.zh: 3.6.4 保卫儿童国际

blocks.en: IDEFICS (Image-aware Decoder Enhanced à la Flamingo with Interleaved Cross-attentionS) is an open source MLLM model that is a reproduction of Flamingo, which is a closed source visual language model. The model has the ability to process visual information from images and answer questions. IDEFICS builds on two pretrained parent models—CLIP ViT-H/14 (trained on LAION-2B) and LLaMA-65 B. Both are open-access, unimodal models that enable IDEFICS to bridge two modalities: text and image. The model has two variants: one with 9 billion parameters and the other one with 80 billion parameters. For our study, we have opted for the 9B parameter one.
blocks.zh: IDEFICS(Image-aware Decoder Endated à la Flamingo with Interleaved Cross-attentionS)是一种开源的MLLM模型,是弗拉明戈的复制品,是一种闭源视觉语言模型. 该模型具有从图像处理视觉信息和回答问题的能力. 国防和社会保障研究所利用两个经过预先培训的母型——CLIP VIT-H/14(LAION-2B培训)和LLaMA-65 B。 两者都是开放的单式模式,使IDFICS能够连接两种模式:文本和图像. 该模型有两个变体:一个有90亿参数,另一个有800亿参数. 对于我们的研究,我们选择了9B参数1。

blocks.en: 3.7 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.7 执行细节

blocks.en: To start with, a few preprocessing was done on the images to make sure the input format was compatible with the Swin transformer backbone. The trap images were in grayscale format after augmentation which were converted into RGB format with three channels to meet the input requirement of Swin Transformer using PIL’s method. Following that, the images were resized to a standard size of 224*224 pixels to maintain a compatible format for the patch embedding process.
blocks.zh: 首先,在图像上做了一些预处理,以确保输入格式与Swin变压器主干线兼容. 陷阱图像在增强后采用灰色尺度格式,这些图像被转换成RGB格式,有三个信道,以满足Swin Transformer使用PIL方法的输入要求。 之后,图像被调整为224*224像素的标准尺寸,以维持补丁嵌入过程的兼容格式.

blocks.en: After that, the images were passed into the Swin Tiny backbone for feature extraction. There, the input images were divided into windows of non-overlapping patches with a size of 4*4 pixels, so the 224*224 input images with 3 dimensions were converted into 3136 tokens. Every single token or patch was linearly embedded into a feature vector of 96 dimensions. Swin tiny has a hierarchical structure with four stages, each consisting of two sections that computes window based multi-head self-attention and shifted window based multi-head self-attention alternatively. Each of the stages has a different number of transformer blocks which are 2,2,6 and 2 accordingly. In every stage, the patches were merged together reducing the resolution and scaling the feature dimension by a factor of 2. By leveraging window based self-attention computation combined with the shifted window mechanism, the model extracted multi-scale hierarchical features from every stage which included precise details along with global context from the trap images.
blocks.zh: 之后,画面传入Swin Tiny主干线进行特征提取. 在那里,输入图像被分为非重叠补丁的窗口,大小为4*4像素,因此3维的224*224输入图像被转换成3136个令牌. 每个符号或补丁都被线性地嵌入到96维的特征矢量中. Swin tini有一个分级结构,分四个阶段,每个阶段由两个部分组成,分别计算基于窗口的多头自留心和基于转移窗口的多头自留心。 每个级都有不同的变压器区块,分别为2,2,6和2个相应的变压器区块. 在每一个阶段,补丁被合并在一起,将分辨率和特征维度缩小2倍. 通过利用基于窗口的自我关注计算与转移窗口机制相结合,该模型从每个阶段提取了多层次的层次特征,其中包括精确的细节以及来自陷阱图像的全球背景。

blocks.en: Subsequently, these hierarchical features extracted from four stages were passed onto a 4 level BiFPN architecture, which has three layers with cross-scale connection across non-contiguous levels. The bidirectional feature network fused features from both top-down (p6->p5->p4->p3) and bottom-up (p3->p4->p5->p6) direction ensuring that every feature level had both higher level features along with lower level details. At each layer, BiFPN utilized dynamic weighted feature fusion to evaluate the impact of the features and their contributions which enhanced the overall representation in consecutive layers.
blocks.zh: 随后,从四个阶段提取的这些等级特征被传递到一个4级的BiFPN架构中,该架构有三层,跨非毗连层的跨级连接. 双向特性网络从自上而下(p6->p5->p4->p3)和自下而上(p3->p4->p5->p6)两个方向连接起来的特性,确保每个特性级别既具有较高的特性,又具有较低的职等细节。 在每一层中,BiFPN都利用动态加权特性聚变来评价这些特性的影响及其贡献,这些作用提高了连续各层的整体代表性。

blocks.en: After that, the multi-scale feature maps were sent to the Faster R-CNN architecture for final classification. In the training phase, AdamW optimizer was implemented with a learning rate and weight decay of 0.0001. The training was conducted using a batch size of 32 over 10 epochs and a CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts scheduler was utilized to elevate the learning rate with a minimum rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} and T_0=5 was set, creating a dual learning cycle which accelerated the convergence.
blocks.zh: 之后,多尺度的地物地图被送往更快的R-CNN架构进行最终分类. 在培训阶段,实施了AdamW优化器,学习率和体重衰减率为0.0001. 培训采用批量规模为32个10个世纪,并使用CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts排程器提高学习率,最低速度为1×10−6 1\time 10×6}和T_0=5,创造了双重学习周期,加快了融合。

blocks.en: In table 4.6 and 4.5 , comparisons among four different architectures based on both the raw and augmented test sets, in terms of precision, recall and mAP is presented. The ViT+FRCNN model performs poorly compared to others, with precision at 0.1121 for both raw and augmented test sets, while recall drops from 0.1476 (raw) to 0.1137 (augmented) and mAP declines from 0.1358 (raw) to 0.1129 (augmented). The class-wise mAP result from table 4.7 shows that, the model detects only three classes (Deer, Frog, Tiger) on the raw test set, with low mAPs (0.0385, 0.1218, 0.1201), which are failing to reach the acceptable benchmark, while smaller classes remain undetected. Class-wise performance deteriorates further when evaluated on the augmented test set, showing no detection for the "Deer" class 4.8 . These observations can be explained by the underlying mechanisms of ViT: ViT converts the images into fixed patches of 16x16 ratios, and treat these patches as sequences of tokens similar to natural language processing. After this, using the self attention mechanism, ViT calculates the attention weights that determine how much influence the patch should have on feature representations. This method excels in capturing the global context, however, it lacks the ability to focus on fine-grained localized features that are essential for animal detection, such as a tiger’s stripes. This critical limitation explains ViT’s underperformance in animal detection.
blocks.zh: 在表4.6和4.5中,在精确度、召回率和mAP方面,根据原始测试机组和扩增测试机组对四个不同的架构进行比较。 与其他模型相比,ViT+FRCNN模型性能不佳,原始测试机组和增强测试机组的精度为0.1121,而召回率则从0.1476(粗)降至0.1137(粗),mAP从0.1358(粗)降至0.1129(粗). 类的mAP从表4.7得到的结果显示,模型在原始测试集中检测到的只有三个类(鹿,蛙,虎),低的mAP(0.0385,0.1218,0.1201),它们未能达到可接受的基准,而较小的类则仍未被发现. 在增强测试集上评价时,类性能会进一步恶化,显示"鹿"类4.8没有检测. 这些观测可以用ViT的内在机制来解释:ViT将图像转换成16x16比例的固定补丁,并将这些补丁作为类似于自然语言处理的令牌的序列来对待. 在此之后,ViT利用自我关注机制计算出关注权重,以确定补丁对特征表达应有多大影响. 然而,这种方法在捕捉全球背景方面非常出色,它缺乏专注于对动物探测至关重要的精细的局部特征的能力,如虎纹。 这一关键限制解释了ViT在动物检测中表现不佳的原因.

blocks.en: The Swin+FPN+FRCNN architecture exhibits better performance based on all metrics compared to both Resnet50 and ViT backbone frameworks, assessed on both test sets. The overall average precision of 0.8156, recall of 0.7915 and mAP of 0.7904 on the raw test set (table 4.5 ) faces a slight reduction on the augmented test set with a precision of 0.7669, recall of 0.7478 and mAP of 0.7476 (table 4.6 ). The architecture achieved a balanced performance relatively, in terms of the class-wise mAP results across both raw and augmented test sets compared to the previous models, especially for the Bear (0.8388 and 0.8019), Fox (0.8944 and 0.8278), Tiger (0.9000 and 0.8963) and Turtle (0.5676 and 0.4658) classes. In spite of the smaller training dataset for the Hedgehog class, this architecture shows improvement in terms of reliability. Swin transformer backbone’s hierarchical feature extraction combined with multi-level feature fusion of FPN can detect precise local details along with global context and that helps the model to improve its generalization capability which is the primary reason behind the overall improvement.
blocks.zh: Swin+FPN+FRCNN架构在所有度量标准的基础上表现出更好的性能,而Resnet50和ViT主干框架都是在两个测试集上评估的. 原试验机组上的总平均精度为0.8156,召回0.7915和MAP为0.7904(表4.5),在增加的试验机组上,精确度为0.7669,召回0.7478和MAP为0.7476(表4.6)。 与之前的型号相比,该架构相对地取得了平衡的性能,在原生型和扩增型测试集的分级MAP结果方面,尤其是熊号(0.8388和0.8019),福克斯号(0.8944和0.8278),虎号(0.9000和0.8963)和龟号(0.5676和0.4658)级. 尽管Hedgehog班的训练数据集较小,但这种架构在可靠性方面显示出改进. Swin变压器主干线的分级特性提取与多级特性聚变(FPN)结合,可以发现精确的局部细节与全球背景,并有助于模型提高其通缩能力,这是总体改进的主要原因。

blocks.en: The proposed architecture exhibits the most optimal result considering both the testset with an average precision of 0.8343, recall of 0.8178 and 0.8161 mAP on raw test set (table 4.5 ) and precision of 0.8059, recall of 0.7919 and mAP of 0.7889 for augmented test set (table 4.6 ). The class-wise mAP for raw test set (table 4.7 ) demonstrates consistent improvement across classes, with a notable increase for the Fox class (0.9176). The Turtle class achieves low performance with mAP of 0.4935 and 0.4459 respectively for raw and augmented test sets. The bidirectional weighted feature fusion facilitates detection of complex patterns and optimal detection capability combined with the transformer backbone which handles the shortcomings of the previously discussed architectures.
blocks.zh: 拟议的结构显示出最理想的结果,考虑到在原始试验装置上平均精确度为0.8343、召回0.8178和0.8161毫帕的试验套件(表4.5)和0.8059、召回0.7919和扩增试验装置的0.7889毫帕的试验套件(表4.6)。 原始测试集的分级mAP(表4.7)显示各类之间持续改善,福克斯级的分级明显增加(0.9176). Turtle级在原始测试机组和增强测试机组的MAP分别为0.4935和0.4459,实现了低性能. 双向加权特征聚变有助于检测复杂模式和最佳检测能力,并与处理先前讨论的架构缺陷的变压器主干件相结合。

blocks.en: However, there are some key observations regarding the performance of the turtle and tiger classes. While the Swin Transformer combined with the FPN backbone achieves relatively higher mAP scores for these classes: 0.5676 (raw) and 0.4658 (augmented) for turtle, and 0.9000 (raw) and 0.8963 (augmented) for tiger, the Swin+BiFPN architecture demonstrates a decline in performance. The turtle class records a lower mAP of 0.4935 on the raw test set and 0.4459 on the augmented test set, whereas the tiger class records a lower mAP of 0.8469 on the raw test set and 0.8401 on the augmented test set (Figure 4.1 and 4.2 ). This decline could be attributed to a key factor that suggests that the Swin+BiFPN model needs more training epochs to properly learn the distinguishing features extracted by the backbone. Since we had restricted access to resources and there was a time constraint, the model was trained on a lower number of epochs of 10, potentially preventing the network from fully converging and learning more discriminative features. While this would not affect the Swin+FPN backbone, this could have an effect on the Swin+BiFPN backbone due to more fine-grained feature extraction.
blocks.zh: 然而,对于龟和老虎班的表现有一些关键的意见. 虽然Swin变形金刚与FPN主干线结合,在这些类中实现了相对较高的mAP分数:0.5676(raw)和0.4658(agmented)为乌龟,0.9000(raw)和0.8963(agmented)为虎,但Swin+BiFPN架构显示性能下降. 龟类记录的mAP在原始试验机组上为0.4935,在增强试验机组上为0.4459,而虎类记录的mAP在原始试验机组上为0.8469,在增强试验机组上为0.8401(图4.1和4.2). 这种下降可归因于一个关键因素,它表明Swin+BiFPN模式需要更多的培训时代,以适当学习骨干提取的显著特征. 由于我们获得资源的机会受到限制,而且时间有限,因此对模型进行了10个世纪的培训,这有可能使网络无法充分融合,无法学习更歧视性的特点。 虽然这不会影响Swin+FPN主干线,但由于更精细的特征提取,这可能会对Swin+BiFPN主干线产生影响.

blocks.en: Furthermore, the overall performance of the Swin+BiFPN backbone surpasses the Swin+FPN architecture. In the augmented test set, Swin+BiFPN outperforms Swin+FPN in four out of seven classes (Figure 4.2 ). This leads to two key observations: First, the number of training epochs required for the model to learn richer feature representations may have influenced the performance of the Swin+BiFPN backbone and second, the similarity between augmented test images and the training data may contribute positively to the model’s effectiveness in the augmented test set.
blocks.zh: 此外,Swin+BiFPN骨干的整体表现超过了Swin+FPN架构. 在扩增测试集中,Swin+BiFPN在7个班次中的4个班次中超越了Swin+FPN(图4.2). 由此得出两项关键意见: 首先,模型学习更丰富的特征表述所需的培训时期数目可能影响Swin+BiFPN主干网的性能,其次,增强测试图像与培训数据之间的相似性可能积极促进模型在增强测试集中的有效性。

blocks.en: The results presented in this section demonstrate that the proposed object detection framework significantly outperforms traditional object detection models across both the raw and augmented test datasets. Conventional CNN-based object detectors show limited effectiveness in complex and cluttered environments, as found in trap images. In contrast, the integration of a self-attention-based backbone with Bi-FPN for enhanced feature extraction leads to substantial improvements in detection accuracy under challenging environmental conditions. This conclusion is further illustrated in the figures 4.3 and 4.4 where the radar charts show that Swin + Bi-FPN + FRCNN (red) achieves the highest values across all three metrics of precision, recall and mAP, closely followed by Swin + FPN + FRCNN (green) while CNN based model ResNet50 demonstrates lower performance (blue) in both raw and augmented test sets. Notably, despite being trained on a relatively small augmented dataset, the proposed model maintains competitive performance when evaluated on entirely different test images. Since the test images were taken from different datasets, they varied significantly from the images the model was trained on. This observation strongly demonstrates the model’s strong generalization capability which is essential for practical real-world scenarios. The results suggest that with access to larger and more diverse trap image datasets, the model’s generalization power could be further enhanced, making it an even more robust solution for wildlife conservation. Furthermore, the architecture shows promising results in detecting small and partially occluded animals. This capability is particularly critical in wildlife conservation efforts, where traditional models often fall short. Overall, the experimental findings validate the effectiveness of the proposed object detection architecture and demonstrate how attention-based backbones are not only efficient but also achieves higher performance rates.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍的结果显示,拟议的物体探测框架在原始和扩充的测试数据集中明显超过传统物体探测模型。 以CNN为主的常规物体探测器在复杂和杂乱的环境中显示效力有限,如陷阱图像所示。 与此相反,将基于自我的骨干网与双FPN相结合,以加强地物提取,导致在具有挑战性的环境条件下探测精度大幅提高。 图4.3和图4.4进一步说明了这一结论,其中雷达图显示Swin + Bi-FPN + FRCNN(红色)在精确度、召回度和mAP等所有三个度量中都达到了最高值,紧随其后的是Swin + FPN + FRCN(绿色),而基于CNN的ResNet50模型显示在原始测试机和增强测试机中性能较低(蓝色)。 值得注意的是,尽管拟议模型接受了关于一个相对较小的扩大数据集的培训,但在对完全不同的测试图像进行评价时,仍保持了竞争力。 由于测试图像取自不同的数据集,它们与模型所训练的图像差异很大. 这一观察有力地表明,该模型具有强大的通俗化能力,这对于现实世界的实际情况至关重要。 结果显示,通过获取更大、更多样化的陷阱图像数据集,该模型的通用能力可以进一步提高,使其成为保护野生动物的更强有力的解决方案。 此外,该建筑在检测小型和部分被占有的动物方面显示出有希望的结果。 这种能力对于保护野生动物的努力特别重要,因为传统模式往往不足。 总体而言,实验结论验证了拟议对象检测架构的有效性,并表明基于关注的骨干不仅高效,而且能实现更高的性能率.

blocks.en: 4.2 Visual Semantics Extraction Task Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 视觉语义学提取任务评价

blocks.en: After successful animal detection using our proposed Swin-BiFPN-FRCNN network, the next stage of the pipeline involves visual semantic extraction. As discussed earlier, this enables the architecture to introduce zero-shot detection capabilities, as well as providing important and emergent cues of the animal’s behavior, further advancing the conservation effort.
blocks.zh: 在利用我们提议的Swin-BiFPN-FRCNN网络成功检测动物后,下一阶段的管道涉及视觉语义提取. 如前所述,这让建筑能够引入零镜头探测能力,以及提供动物行为的重要和紧急提示,进一步推动保护工作。

blocks.en: Zero-Shot Detection: Zero-shot detection refers to the task where a model can identify and localize objects of a category without any prior training examples. This contrasts with the traditional object detection, where models are trained on labeled data for each class they are expected to detect.
blocks.zh: 零热检测 : 零镜头探测(Oero-shot survey)是指一个模型可以在没有任何事先训练实例的情况下识别某类对象并将其定位的任务. 这与传统的物体探测形成对比,在这种探测中,模型在标注数据方面接受了培训,为预期要探测的每类数据。

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of the generated description, five Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) were assessed. These include LlaVa v1.5 7B, LlaVa v1.5 13B, LlaVa v1.6 Mistral, KOSMOS 2 and IDEFICS instruct 9B. Each of the five MLLMs evaluated in this study is publicly available as an open-source model on the Hugging Face Hub. Although BLIP-2 was initially included in the evaluation, it consistently failed to generate meaningful or contextually relevant descriptions. As a result, the model was excluded from further analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了评价生成的描述的有效性,对五个多式联运大语言模型进行了评估。 其中包括LlaVa v1.5 7B,LlaVa v1.5 13B,LlaVa v1.6 Mistral,KOSMOS 2和IDRICS指示9B. 本研究中评价的5个MLLMs都作为开源模型在Hugging Face Hub上公开提供. 虽然最初将BLIP-2列入评价,但它始终未能产生有意义的或与背景相关的描述。 因此,该模型被排除在进一步分析之外。

blocks.en: To quantitatively assess the semantic relevance and accuracy of the generated descriptions, we have followed a dual-approach: a) Textual similarity analysis using BERTScore and SBERT cosine similarity against the ground truth caption. b) LLM as a Judge: where two strong language models, GPT-4.1 and GROK 3.0, acted as a ‘judge’ to compare the different outputs and generate score based on relevance, accuracy, depth, and fluency. This dual evaluation strategy enables assessment of the captions relative to ground-truth references as well as through direct comparison between model outputs.
blocks.zh: 为了从数量上评估生成的描述的语义相关性和准确性,我们遵循了一种双轨制:(a) 使用BERTScore和SBERT同位素相似度对地面真象标题进行文字相似度分析。 (b) LLM作为一名法官:GPT-4.1和GROK 3.0这两个强有力的语文模型充当 " 法官 " ,根据相关性、准确性、深度和流利性比较不同的产出并产生分数。 这一双重评价战略有助于评估与地面实况参考资料有关的标题,并通过对模型产出的直接比较。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Textual Similarity Results
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 文字相似性结果

blocks.en: Table 4.9 : Evaluation of MLLM Models using BERTScore and SBERT Cosine Similarity
blocks.zh: 表4.9:使用BERTS分数和SBERTCosine相似度对MLLM模型的评价

blocks.en: Table 4.9 summarizes the performance evaluation of the five MLLMs using BERTScore (Precision, Recall, F1 Score) and SBERT Cosine Similarity against referenced captions. The LlaVa v1.5 13B achieved the highest SBERT similarity (0.6501), indicating good semantic alignment with the ground-truth. Furthermore, the high precision (0.8952), recall (0.9007), and F1 score (0.8978) indicate the model’s ability to generate accurate and comprehensive descriptions, including key information. One concern regarding this model was its relatively higher parameter count compared to the others. However, timing tests revealed that LLaVA v1.5 (13B) required only 1.23 minutes to generate descriptions over an image, whereas LLaVA v1.6 Mistral, despite having fewer parameters (7B), took 2 minutes to complete.
blocks.zh: 表4.9概述了使用BERTScore(精度、回忆、F1分数)和SBERT Cosine相似度对五个MLLMs的性能评价。 LlaVa v1.5 13B实现了最高的SBERT相似性(0.6501),表明语义上与地面真实性一致良好. 此外,高精度(0.8952)、回顾(0.9007)和F1分(0.8978)表明该模型有能力产生准确和全面的描述,包括关键信息。 与其它模型相比,该模型的参数数相对较高。 然而,计时测试显示LLaVA v1.5(13B)只需要1.23分钟就可以对一个图像生成描述,而LLaVA v1.6 Mistral尽管参数较少(7B),却需要2分钟才能完成.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 LLM-as-a-Judge
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 LLM 现职法官

blocks.en: To ensure comprehensive and contrastive evaluation across all five MLLMs, we also employed the LLM-as-a-judge evaluation approach. The ‘judge’ models’ extensive parameters allow it to process and compare all five model outputs concurrently. This approach allows both qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the generated descriptions.
blocks.zh: 为确保对所有5个最低劳动标准妇女进行全面和具有对比性的评价,我们还采用了作为法官进行最低劳动标准评价的方法。 " 法官 " 模式的广泛参数使它能同时处理和比较所有五个模式产出。 这种方法可以对生成的描述进行定性和定量评估。

blocks.en: Table 4.10 : LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation using GPT 4.1
blocks.zh: 表4.10: 使用通用程序评价法官的LLM-as-a-法官

blocks.en: Table 4.11 : LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation using GROK 3.0
blocks.zh: 表4.11:使用希腊文库3.0的LLM-as-a-法官评价

blocks.en: The models selected for this approach are GPT-4.1 and GROK 3.0. Tables 4.10 and 4.11 present the evaluation results from each judge, respectively. GPT 4.1 is an advanced state-of-the-art language model with strong contextual comprehension, and GROK 3.0 features advanced reasoning capabilities, making them both well-suited for the evaluation. The judges were prompted (Go to Prompt) to assess the outputs from all five models scoring each on a scale from 0 to 1 across four metrics: relevance, accuracy, depth, and fluency and then the scores were combined to provide an overall total. Based on the evaluations from both judges, LLaVA v1.5 (13B) achieved the highest scores, receiving a total of 3.1806 from GPT-4.1 and 3.55 from GROK 3.0. These results further support the BERTScore and SBERT findings. To mitigate potential biases from the LLM judges, the order of the output files was randomized during evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为这种方法选定的模型是GPT-4.1和GROK 3.0. 表4.10和4.11分别列出每位法官的评价结果。 GPT 4.1是一个先进的最先进的语言模型,具有很强的背景理解,GROK 3.0具有先进的推理能力,使得两者都非常适合评价. 法官们被促动(Go to Power)对所有五个模型的产出进行评估,每个模型的评分比例从0到1,分为四个衡量标准:相关性、准确性、深度和流利度,然后将分数合并,得出一个总体总数。 根据两位法官的评价,LLaVA v1.5(13B)的得分最高,总共从GPT-4.1和GROK 3.5得到3.1806分. 这些结果进一步支持了BERTScore和SBERT的调查结果。 为了减少LLM法官的潜在偏见,在评价期间随机排列了产出文件的顺序。

blocks.en: Figure 4.5 : Zero-shot detection: While the object detection network misclassified a horse as a deer due to lack of training data, the MLLM correctly identified it, highlighting the complementary strength of vision-language models in refining detection outcomes as a fallback option
blocks.zh: 图4.5:零射线探测: 虽然天体检测网络由于缺乏训练数据而误将一匹马归类为一头鹿,但MLLM正确识别了它,凸显了视觉语言模型在精炼检测结果方面的互补力量,作为倒置选项.

blocks.en: Figure 4.5 illustrates a scenario where the detection module fails to correctly classify an image belonging to a category it was not trained on. In contrast, the MLLM successfully identifies the object, demonstrating the framework’s zero-shot capability and highlighting the enhanced robustness achieved through the integration of the MLLM. This integration serves as a complementary fallback mechanism to the detection network, enhancing overall system reliability in unfamiliar scenarios.
blocks.zh: 图4.5显示了一种情况,即检测模块未能正确划分属于某一类别、但未受过训练的图像。 相比之下,MLLM成功识别了对象,展示了框架的零射能力,并突出了通过MLLM集成而实现的增强强性. 这种整合是检测网络的一个补充倒置机制,在不熟悉的情景中提高了系统的整体可靠性。

blocks.en: To summarize, the presented architecture in this research demonstrates a detailed framework for wildlife conservation and management efforts with enhanced animal detection capabilities along with meaningful textual descriptions. The proposed object detection model (Swin+Bi-FPN+F-RCNN) obtained a remarkable result with a high precision of 0.8343 (raw) and 0.8059 (augmented) and recall of 0.8178 (raw) and 0.7919 (augmented), which indicates strong generalization capability and promising detection capabilities in low contrast environments and it is indispensable for conservation strategies such as population count. Also the model managed to detect small animals with a relatively high mAP in complex backgrounds which is essential for wildlife scenarios. The implementation of MLLM model, particularly LLaVA-1.5-13b-hf, achieves superior performance (F1 score: 0.8978), generates meaningful and relevant descriptions of the species, leverages zero-shot detection capabilities and which is vital for monitoring unknown endangered wildlife species. Therefore, this comprehensive pipeline fuses object detection with adequate language modeling ability that introduces a functional, efficient and reliable framework for wildlife conservation, leading to improved monitoring systems for preservation.
blocks.zh: 概括地说,本研究中介绍的结构表明,野生动物养护和管理工作有一个详细的框架,动物探测能力得到加强,并有有意义的文字描述。 拟议的物体探测模型(Swin+Bi-FPN+F-RCNN)以0.8343(raw)和0.8059(auguped)的高精度获得了显著成果,并召回了0.8178(raw)和0.7919(auguped),这表明了在低对比环境下的强通化能力和有希望的探测能力,对于人口计数等保护战略是不可或缺的. 此外,该模型还能够检测到在复杂背景中具有相对较高的mAP的小型动物,这对于野生动物情况至关重要。 实施MLLM模型,特别是LLaVA-1.5-13b-hf,取得了优异的性能(F1得分:0.8978),对物种产生了有意义的相关描述,利用了零镜头探测能力,这对监测未知的濒危野生动植物物种至关重要. 因此,这种综合管线引信具有适当的语言建模能力,可以引入一个实用、高效和可靠的野生生物保护框架,从而改进保护监测系统。

blocks.en: 4.3 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 4.3 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: While this study demonstrates how the proposed framework can contribute to successful wildlife conservation, some limitations must be acknowledged that present opportunities for further enhancement. Firstly, due to time retrains and limited access to resources, the models were trained for a relatively lower number of epochs. This may explain the Swin+BiFPN model’s reduced ability to effectively learn and generalize fine-grained features. Secondly, the dataset was augmented to mimic the trap image-like challenges due to the unavailability of trap images. Hence, the dataset was limited and smaller, which may have affected the model’s performance. Furthermore, although the framework shows some capabilities of zero-shot detection, using the MLLM model, the detection framework still relies on a trained dataset.
blocks.zh: 虽然这项研究表明拟议框架如何有助于成功地保护野生生物,但必须承认一些局限性为进一步加强提供了机会。 首先,由于时间流逝和获得资源的机会有限,这些模型的培训对象相对较少。 这也许可以解释Swin+BiFPN模型在有效学习和概括精细特征方面的能力下降的原因. 第二,由于无法获取陷阱图像,数据集得以扩充,以模仿陷阱图像般的挑战。 因此,数据集有限且较小,可能影响模型的性能。 此外,虽然框架显示一些零射探测能力,但使用MLLM模型,探测框架仍然依赖于训练有素的数据集.

blocks.en: The future work for this study includes several key directions aiming at enhancing the effectiveness of the model. First, integrating object segmentation alongside detection can further enhance the model’s feature learning capability. Second, introducing zero-shot capability in the overall framework by leveraging LLM models within the object detection module would allow the system to be more robust by enabling the system to detect and describe previously unseen object categories without requiring additional training data. Lastly, optimizing inference speed to further support the conservation effort at a low computational cost.
blocks.zh: 这项研究今后的工作包括几个关键方向,旨在提高模型的有效性。 首先,将物体分离与探测结合起来,可以进一步提高模型的特性学习能力。 其次,通过在物体检测模块中利用LLM模型,在总体框架中引入零射能力,将使系统能够更强大,使系统能够探测和描述以前未见的物体类别,而不需要额外的训练数据. 最后,优化推论速度,以低计算成本进一步支持养护工作。
